desc: The Magpul BSL Pistol Stabilizing Brace is designed for AR style buffer tubes and improves single handed firing of AR pistols. Made from high quality polymer, the BSL arm brace comes with a host of features such as an easy-to-use adjustment mechanism, QD sling swivel slot, and two M-LOK slots allowing you to easily attach additional sling mounting options, With the use of a sling, you can further stabilize your pistol for more accurate shooting. Improve your rifle style pistol with the Magpul BSL arm brace.
